# Nexusbizz

> Nexusbizz LLC is a United States company that builds AI agents, AI development and AI implementation for businesses, and is the parent company of three ventures: Nepo Commerce, Fayaa Tech and Sohae Finance. Its studio also builds websites and AI video for brands.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Nexusbizz LLC (United States). Works with clients worldwide, remotely.
- Core service: AI agents for sales, customer support and operations (WhatsApp, web chat, email, voice), connected to payments, inventory and CRMs.
- Also: custom AI development (LLM features, retrieval over company documents, extraction pipelines) and AI implementation into existing systems.
- Typical first agent goes live in 2–6 weeks. Model-agnostic.
- Contact: hello@nexusbizz.com or the brief form at https://www.nexusbizz.com/contact (reply within two business days).

## Services

- [AI agents, AI development & implementation](https://www.nexusbizz.com/ai-agents): what we build, how we deliver, FAQ
- [Studio](https://www.nexusbizz.com/studio): AI agents, AI development, websites, AI video
- [Contact / start a project](https://www.nexusbizz.com/contact): four-step project brief

## Ventures

- [Nepo Commerce](https://www.nexusbizz.com/ventures/nepo-commerce): commerce infrastructure for brands that sell everywhere: storefronts, payments and WhatsApp ordering. Formerly known as getreech.
- [Fayaa Tech](https://www.nexusbizz.com/ventures/fayaa-tech): AI video and creative generation for brands.
- [Sohae Finance](https://www.nexusbizz.com/ventures/sohae-finance): a renewable energy investment platform.
